subject: [PATCH v3 4/8] nfsd: don't vet delegated times against an exclusive-create verifier

2026-11-09.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the NFSv4 server where delegated times are not properly vetted against an exclusive-create verifier. When a client performs an exclusive create, the server stores the client's verifier in atime and mtime until the client sets real times. However, when a delegation is granted on this OPEN, the holder's times are always accepted, including times older than the file itself. The patch introduces a new function to set time floors for delegated timestamps, which uses the ctime as the floor for atime and mtime in case of an exclusive create. This ensures that the server properly rejects times equal to their floor and allows holders to replace the verifier with a time equal to the ctime.
